description: Use this when someone asks how buying, selling, renting or letting a home in Singapore works: grants and eligibility, BTO and resale, stamp duty, loans and down payments, the MOP, tenancy agreements, or renting out a flat or room. Also use it when a property agent asks how Homejourney works for agents: co-broking and CEA rules, verifying with Singpass, listing for clients, and viewing requests. Also use it when someone asks how to manage their Homejourney account: changing the sign-in email, resetting the password, verifying the email, or editing the profile. Returns Homejourney's reviewed guides and help articles that match, each with its URL, a short answer, who it is for (no persona means everyone), whether it has a calculator, and the date it was last checked. Cite the URL and its date. Filter with persona (buyer, seller, renter, landlord, foreigner or agent); leave query empty to list every guide for that persona. The guides cover Singapore. For buying or renting in another country, pass market (such as MY or JP): it returns that market's rule facts on who may buy, purchase taxes, loan limits and renting, each with its official source and checked date, the sites that list homes there, and its Homejourney page. Needs no sign-in.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as MY or JP. Left out, the guides cover Singapore.
